UPDATE leads l
SET
  status = 'approved',
  updated_at = NOW(),
  failure_reason = 'Recovered after an interrupted email send'
WHERE l.status = 'sending'
  AND l.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM email_logs el
    WHERE el.lead_id = l.id
      AND el.status = 'sent'
  );

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT
    l.id,
    l.business_name,
    l.email,
    l.campaign_id,
    d.id AS draft_id,
    d.subject AS email_subject,
    d.body AS email_body
  FROM leads l
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ed.id, ed.subject, ed.body
    FROM email_drafts ed
    WHERE ed.lead_id = l.id
      AND ed.status = 'approved'
    ORDER BY ed.updated_at DESC, ed.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) d ON TRUE
  WHERE l.status = 'approved'
    AND l.email IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.email) <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM email_logs own_log
      WHERE own_log.lead_id = l.id
        AND own_log.status = 'sent'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM leads other
      JOIN email_logs sent_log
        ON sent_log.lead_id = other.id
       AND sent_log.status = 'sent'
      WHERE other.campaign_id = l.campaign_id
        AND other.id <> l.id
        AND (
          LOWER(TRIM(other.email)) = LOWER(TRIM(l.email))
          OR LOWER(TRIM(other.business_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(l.business_name))
        )
    )
  ORDER BY l.audited_at ASC NULLS LAST, l.updated_at ASC
  LIMIT {{ $('config').first().json.batchSize }}
  FOR UPDATE OF l SKIP LOCKED
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    status = 'sending',
    failure_reason = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM picked p
  WHERE l.id = p.id
  RETURNING l.id
)
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.business_name,
  p.email,
  p.campaign_id,
  p.draft_id,
  p.email_subject,
  p.email_body
FROM picked p
JOIN claimed c ON c.id = p.id;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
) VALUES (
  'email_send',
  NOW(),
  0,
  0,
  0,
  'no approved email drafts in queue'
);

WITH lead_updated AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET
    status = 'sent',
    sent_at = NOW(),
    failure_reason = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
    AND status = 'sending'
  RETURNING id
), draft_updated AS (
  UPDATE email_drafts
  SET
    status = 'sent',
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = {{ $json.draft_id }}
    AND status = 'approved'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_logs (
  lead_id,
  draft_id,
  email_to,
  email_subject,
  email_body,
  status,
  smtp_response,
  sent_at
)
SELECT
  {{ $json.id }},
  {{ $json.draft_id }},
  '{{ $json.email.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.email_subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.email_body.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'sent',
  '{{ $json.smtp_response.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW()
FROM lead_updated
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM draft_updated);

WITH lead_updated AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET
    status = 'send_failed',
    retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    failure_reason = '{{ ($json.send_error || "Unknown SMTP error").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
    AND status = 'sending'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_logs (
  lead_id,
  draft_id,
  email_to,
  email_subject,
  email_body,
  status,
  smtp_response,
  sent_at
)
SELECT
  {{ $json.id }},
  {{ $json.draft_id }},
  '{{ $json.email.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.email_subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.email_body.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'failed',
  '{{ ($json.send_error || "Unknown SMTP error").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW()
FROM lead_updated;

WITH lead_updated AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET
    status = 'send_failed',
    retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    failure_reason = '{{ ($json.validation_error || "Invalid approved email").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
    AND status = 'sending'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_logs (
  lead_id,
  draft_id,
  email_to,
  email_subject,
  email_body,
  status,
  smtp_response,
  sent_at
)
SELECT
  {{ $json.id }},
  {{ $json.draft_id }},
  '{{ ($json.email || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.email_subject || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.email_body || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'failed',
  '{{ ($json.validation_error || "Invalid approved email").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW()
FROM lead_updated;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
)
SELECT
  'email_send',
  NOW(),
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'sent' AND updated_at >= '{{ $json.run_start_ts }}'::timestamptz),
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'send_failed' AND updated_at >= '{{ $json.run_start_ts }}'::timestamptz),
  {{ $json.duration_ms }},
  '{{ $json.notes.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
FROM leads;
